Proof of general higher education entrance qualification or a foreign school-leaving certificate recognised as equivalent.

notes: The tuition fee found (7,340 EUR per semester) is from the EBS Fees Schedule valid for the Bachelor in Law, Politics and Economics from intake Fall Term 2023. The DAAD page also says 'The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: all countries 9,080 EUR' without specifying period. Both figures are unverified for the current year and may vary; verify with the university. No statement about a French language requirement was found. Application is directly via the EBS application portal; no uni-assist or VPD mention was found. Deadlines are only recommendations, not official fixed deadlines.
